mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate decline below 1.5% triggers immediate equity market relief as investors price in aggressive monetary stimulus, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals strengthening labor market conditions and consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST rising + UNRATE falling) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >55% of instances, or interaction term coefficient is insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), rising labor force participation (PAYEMS) indicates sustained job growth that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 in this regime.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output and supply chain strength, correlating with improved corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1600 thousand units signal strong consumer demand for durable goods, triggering positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days as retail sales and corporate revenues accelerate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when HOUST > 1600, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) combined with stable interest rates (FEDFUNDS within ±0.5% of current level) signals moderate inflation transition, driving equity rallies as earnings growth accelerates over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% + FEDFUNDS stable) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >55% of instances, or interaction term is insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high retail sales regimes (RSAFS > 500,000 million dollars), rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates synchronized consumer demand and manufacturing strength, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when RSAFS > 500,000 and INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 in this regime.
